question: In September 2025, the Supreme Court directed the Election Commission of India to treat which of the following documents as the 12th valid proof of identity for inclusion in Bihar’s revised voters’ list?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aadhaar Card**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **September 2025**, the **Supreme Court** issued a significant directive to the **Election Commission of India (ECI)** regarding the electoral process in **Bihar**.
 
• The court ordered that the **Aadhaar Card** be recognized as the **12th valid proof of identity** specifically for inclusion and verification in **Bihar’s revised voters’ list**.
 
• This decision was aimed at addressing discrepancies in the **Electoral Roll** and ensuring a more inclusive registration process for **voters** who may lack other forms of traditional identification.
 
• The **Aadhaar Card**, which is a **12-digit unique identity number** issued by the **Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI)**, serves as a robust tool for verifying the **identity** and **residence** of a person.
 
• The directive emphasizes the use of technology and centralized databases to eliminate **duplicate entries** and **bogus voters** from the revised lists in the state of **Bihar**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Election Commission of India (ECI):**

 
 
• The **ECI** is an autonomous **constitutional authority** responsible for administering election processes in India as per **Article 324** of the **Constitution**.
 
• It oversees elections to the **Lok Sabha**, **Rajya Sabha**, **State Legislative Assemblies**, and the offices of the **President** and **Vice President**.
 
 
 
• **Valid Identity Proofs for Voting:**
 
 
• Traditionally, the **ECI** accepts several documents for identification at polling stations, including the **Elector Photo Identity Card (EPIC)**, **Passport**, **Driving License**, and **Service Identity Cards** issued by **Central/State Government**.
 
• Other recognized documents include **PAN Card**, **MNREGA Job Card**, and **Health Insurance Smart Cards** issued under the scheme of the **Ministry of Labour**.
 
 
 
• **Aadhaar-Voter ID Linking:**
 
 
• The **Election Laws (Amendment) Act, 2021**, allowed for the voluntary linking of **Aadhaar** with **Voter IDs** to curb the menace of **multiple enrollments** of the same person in different places.
 
• The **Supreme Court’s** intervention often balances the need for **electoral integrity** with the **Right to Privacy** and the **Right to Vote**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Bihar State Context:** **Bihar** has **243 Legislative Assembly constituencies** and **40 Lok Sabha seats**, making the accuracy of its **voter database** critical for **National Politics**.
 
• **Legal Framework:** The preparation and revision of **Electoral Rolls** are governed by the **Representation of the People Act, 1950** and the **Registration of Electors Rules, 1960**.
 
• **UIDAI:** The **Unique Identification Authority of India** was established in **2009** and functions under the **Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)**.
 
• **Role of the Judiciary:** The **Supreme Court** acts as a guardian of the **Constitution**, ensuring that the **Election Commission** maintains the **purity of elections** through fair **voter identification** practices.
